title: What's New: Enhanced Document Reporting (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Updated Word add-in and UX improvements
Data picker enhancements and dark mode
Report selection pages and API expansion

features.name: Enhanced data picker UX
features.description: Improved user experience for the data picker in the Word add-in with BC theme, easier navigation of nested levels, double-click insertion, and automatic cursor movement in tables.

features.name: Data picker search and filter
features.description: New filter section in the data picker allowing users to search and filter by typing to find related fields across different levels and labels.

features.name: Dark mode for data picker
features.description: Dark mode support added to the data picker for users who prefer dark mode interface.

features.name: Insert table action
features.description: Preview feature introducing a new insert table action in the data control section that helps build and populate tables in one place with customizable columns, headers, and data items.
features.status_evidence_quote: we want to make the experience easier for everybody and that's why in preview we are releasing a new action.

features.name: Layout lifecycle and status management
features.description: New ability to manage user-defined layouts through lifecycle states: draft, pending approval, approved, and retired. Only approved layouts are shown to users on report request pages.
caveats: only for user-defined layouts, not for app-deployed layouts in this release

features.name: Company-level default language for documents
features.description: New feature to set a company-level default language for document reports when no language is specified on the customer card, helping multi-national companies manage document language consistently.

features.name: Refactored tooltips on table level
features.description: Refactoring of tooltips from page level down to table level that will eventually light up in the report Word add-in as tooltips.

features.name: Modernized report selection pages
features.description: Modernized report selection pages in the application with teaching tips and aligned caption names and categories across all report selection pages, coming in 28.x.
features.status_evidence_quote: As part of this, we also modernized the report selection pages in the application. This is coming in 28.x.

features.name: 36 new document type APIs
features.description: 36 new APIs for document types covering sales document types, purchasing, inventory, and assembly documents, enabling interaction through Copilot Studio and other automations.
